overview_description.description: Sketshare is a technology startup that provides a real-time collaborative whiteboard platform designed for online meetings, brainstorming, and teamwork. The platform allows users to connect remotely and work together on a shared digital canvas where they can draw, write notes, plan ideas, and communicate in real time.
